entries.text: Guys, I got into a bike crash, my arms are jacked up, I am able to type this with slight pain, but I can't easy bend my arms without extreme pain, same with lifting, or even the pressure applied to when you hold the handlebars on the bike, and I have work tomorrow. Please pray for me, that I will heal, that this is just going to go away tomorrow, that somehow a miracle will occur so I can just miraculously heal, and if not, that I just heal quickly.
Hairline fracture on one arm, and sprained joint on the other. I am going to just focus on healing
Praying for you Liam, in Jesus' name

Super cool thing, but I had to go to base to get an Orthopedic referral, and so I called an Uber, and the guy who drove me, he was military contractor. (Think Military Uber) and that allowed him to enter base and drive me in front of the clinic to meet with my provider, his wife was a Christian missionary. And so we talked about it, and she is from Africa, and she's doing the good work and spreading Christ around.

I am sharing this because I was initially worried I wouldn't be able to get an Orthopedic appointment before work, and so could hurt myself again, however, I had faith, I said God would take care of me. And then he provided, and he gave me the ability to not only get in further then I thought, and save time so I could make it to the last second appointment. But also so I could meet and pray over two faithful people who love Christ. God is working in my life, even with a busted arm.

Like last night I went to Cavalry Lake Stevens YA, and bumped into the boyfriend I mentioned a week ago, his name is London, and we had a worship night there too. God is working in my life even now, and I want to share all this that you may have your own faith encouraged. That you can see or hear how God is working in my life, to know hes working in yours. 

God bless, y'all. 

P.S. David, I'd love to get some of your pamphlets, I'd love to give them away if I could. Even with broken arm. 💪
Amen and absolutely will do! I'll meet up with you to give you more of these flyers. That's so amazing to hear!!!
Before our service starts tonight, I'm asking everyone who can, please lift up our team in prayer to Jesus so we can carry out our work today. Thank you brothers and sisters. God bless you🙏

Prayer Request 8/21/2026:

Praying for Jenna, she's a homeless person right next to our home and I noticed her on her way to the bus station, she was smoking but I offered her the word of God, water, and snacks and she accepted

Hope to bring her to a church and encounter Jesus and then I asked her to meet me on Monday so I could bring her to our young adults
Can we also pray for Brandon per his request, his arborist test coming up soon and for better sleep schedule for him!

Prayer Request 8/24/2026:

I have a prayer request for Sophia. We're praying that she gets comfort from Jesus because she's concerned for her mother who has passed away and claims to be a Christian. She's also planning to visit our young adults and she's pregnant, so let's pray for that. 

Let's pray that Jesus brings more young adults in His name

Brothers & sisters, I also want to raise up Sam in prayer especially in India where it's very difficult to minister and be a disciple of Jesus Christ 

We want to see India 4 Jesus
Sam Elijah this is our prayer and thanksgiving topic thread, please feel free to post here and other topics

Prayer Request 8/25/2026:

I have a prayer request for the salvation of Miliena so she comes unto Christ. I went out on a date with her and spent about an hour covering various topics including faith and tried to get her to understand what is the point of salvation and how she can experience joy in her life from Jesus.

She had a good time but she ultimately didn't decide however she did take a Bible with her as a reminder of the date and I was able to plant a seed that I prayed for.
Thank you Liam, I'm also praying for her

I decided to be brave, I had a phyciatrist appointment, and we decided to cut my med dose from 20mg to 10mg for anxiety and depression, and so I am going to probably really struggle when I make that change to my med dose, next month. So please pray I have the courage to fight the lows the meds used to manage. That God may transform my mind in those weeks to come next month, and people will be there to support me in those moments when the hurt gets too much. I want to be made whole... transform my mind and soul. And so In faith I do this.  This process will probably start late September after YA camp at SOLYA, so if suddenly I go rogue, I literally might not be in my right mind.
what a week for reflection and how God moves, deeply hurting for our young adults and praying in Jesus' name
